data.name: Lyndel
data.long_meaning: The name Lyndel is a combination of the names Lynn and Delia. In Greek mythology, Delia is a name associated with the god Apollo and the goddess Artemis. The name Lynn comes from the Old English word 'lynne', meaning 'pool, pond'. This name may be considered a modern variant of Lindsay, which means 'linden tree'.
